issues.title: In new location control for json-editor, show activity name, not id
issues.body:
We have a workaround for a dedicated location control:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/200784605-e522b250-af18-4428-b600-9202fc51b13d.png)

But, it is showing the geometry id, not the full name.  Modify the `mangler` to use the activity name in `collapseLocation`
